title: omaflake module (module.toml)
description: module.toml (plan B142; v2, plan B147: modes, several keys and modes, after, does, own, title_de): what a module is – its version, the capabilities it provides and needs, the modules it enhances, and the actions people can bind keys to. Its Nix is default.nix next to it.

enhances.description: "<author>/<name>" of modules it adds to when they are in the recipe

runs_in.description: Capabilities whose programs it runs inside (key overlaps)

desktop.description: All its keys work on the whole desktop

own_keys.description: An editor's keys: the key rule does not apply

oneOf.description: A chord – modifiers (Super, Ctrl, Alt, Shift) and a key joined by "+" ("Super+Shift+Return", "Ctrl+g") – or chords separated by spaces ("Space f f"); Digit and Arrow stand for 1–9 and the arrows

items.description: A chord – modifiers (Super, Ctrl, Alt, Shift) and a key joined by "+" ("Super+Shift+Return", "Ctrl+g") – or chords separated by spaces ("Space f f"); Digit and Arrow stand for 1–9 and the arrows

mode.description: Only in this mode of the module, or in these

after.description: The mode the program is in afterwards; without it, it stays

does.description: What it does in the program's own words (Zellij's NewPane "Down"); a module may write the program's configuration from it

own.description: The program's own key, shown for reference – key binding sets do not change it

modes.description: The modes of the module's program: its keys differ there

start.description: The program starts in it (exactly one mode)
